title: They Abandoned Their Tent For An ALL-NIGHT Push #shorts
description:
Drop the tent, keep the sleeping bag, and walk all night to the helicopter.
A mountain stands between them and extraction - knees shaking, a storm rolling in.
#Shorts #NightHike #MountainRace #SurvivalChallenge
